text: You let a fucking hot lead sleep on it, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you, a lazy drawl on 'sleep on it'.

text: Bro, she said, this is exactly what I need. She's booking tonight.
style: Proud and sure of himself, a casual American guy in a diner booth at night, quoting her excitedly, then relaxed and certain on 'she's booking tonight'.

text: It's one in the morning. Spoiler, tonight never comes.
style: Deadpan and dry on the time, a beat, then slow and mock-dramatic on 'tonight never comes'.
Dismissive, waving it off, a little defensive.

text: Maybe. Or she got excited, then cold feet. Psychologists call it the hot-cold empathy gap.
style: Half agreeing on 'Maybe', then suddenly dead serious, low and slow like a documentary narrator, a beat before 'the hot-cold empathy gap'.

text: In your DM, she felt it. Tomorrow, she won't feel it the same.
style: Calm and clear, explaining it simply, a short beat before 'Tomorrow'.

text: One study: hungry people picked more junk food for next week than people who'd just eaten. You ordered tomorrow's burger.
style: Matter-of-fact on the study, then a mocking roast, slow and smug on 'You ordered tomorrow's burger'.

text: So I chase her? I'll look desperate.
style: Frustrated and honest, venting to a friend.

text: No. You finish while she's hot. Plug me into ManyChat.
style: Firm on 'No', punchy on 'while she's hot', then smooth and confident on the offer, a sly little smile.

text: I answer her last question in your voice, check she's a fit, and offer two or three times right in the chat.
style: Confident and easy, listing it calmly, a short beat before 'right in the chat'.

text: How do I set you up?
Eat your pancakes first. You're the hungry guy from the fucking study.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug on 'the hungry guy from the study'.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
